newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm expecting Eurobond debut.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm expecting Eurobond debut.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed before Russia's expected debut Eurobond issue this month, and dealers said on Monday predicted Eurobond levels were making MinFins more attractive for investors.
"Prices have risen earlier ahead of Eurobond issue. It seems that both Russian and Western operators are buying," Most Bank dealer Alexander Rodionov said.

Dealers said some profit-taking was also seen, but buying interest prevailed as MinFins looked attractive compared with expected Eurobond pricing. Dealers expected the Eurobond to come in at 350 basis points or even less over U.S. Treasuries.
"Demand for the Eurobond is likely to be high and MinFins seem relatively cheap in comparison...There is still space on the upside," Moscow Business World Bank dealer Sergei Kovzharov said.
But he said local banks could start selling once prices of the most liquid fourth and fifth tranches reach 61.00 and 44.00, respectively.
